<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS data, the most intense ion is at m/z 276.0666, which corresponds to the [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton (1.007276 Da) gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈275.059 Da. The best matching elemental composition using only C, H, and O that fits this exact mass (within typical high‑resolution error) is C₁₄H₁₁O₆.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H11O6</final_answer>
